summary: Describes a payment application programming interface for version 1.0 of the Internet Open Trading Protocol. IOTP uses a layered design with a generic application core and payment modules, and this document defines how the core talks to the modules.

eli5.summary: A shop's cashier can use cash, card or other ways to pay. This document defines the plug between the cashier and each payment tool.

questions: internet open trading protocol payment modules
